tasks.gr12-integrated-revision-t4: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 4 — Integrated Revision. Ask learners to revise across finance, measurement, maps, data handling and probability using mixed exam-style contexts, select relevant information from case studies, and show clear reasoning for each choice.
tasks.gr12-paper1-readiness-t4: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 4 — Paper 1 Readiness. Ask learners to practise document-heavy finance and data questions, interpret source material accurately, choose correct operations, avoid common Paper 1 errors and manage time effectively in exam-style multiple-choice items.
tasks.gr12-paper2-readiness-t4: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 4 — Paper 2 Readiness. Ask learners to practise maps, plans, measurement, data and probability questions in longer applied contexts, interpret diagrams carefully, keep units consistent, and use exam technique suited to Paper 2 style tasks.
